reply_lines: Did you know? Alan Turing imagined a thinking machine way back in 1936!
He drew it all on paper before any real computer existed.
Turing's imaginary machine read symbols on a long paper tape, one at a time.
That simple idea became the blueprint for every computer today!
Did you know? Turing asked 'can a machine think?' in 1950.
We still ask the same question about helpers like me today!
Almost every modern computer follows the same idea Turing sketched.
One big dream turned into billions of real machines!
Hi! I am Gemini. I know lots of facts about Turing!
Ask me about 'machine' or 'tape' to find out something cool.
